prose.text: The standard gate set runs in the test-plan §3 order.

**Deferred workspace gates.** `capability-drift` precedes the default-features workspace nextest. The workspace Rust gates (`clippy`, the workspace `nextest`, and the `--features mcp-server` bindings regen that follows it) are listed with `defer`, because this chunk changes no `.rs` file, manifest or lockfile. The scope guard proves it, and they re-run at the next source-touching chunk. With no default-features nextest run, nothing rewrites the bindings, so the base-identity close still runs and must read the bindings byte-identical to the base.

**The two real-model entries** are the pre-registered series: - Their measured flags (`--arms`, `--n`, `--min-rank1`) are byte-identical to the predecessor's pre-registered   entries (`2026-10-04-l4-interpretation-names-its-triggering-cue/plan.md`, the two real-model entries). - `--out` is added. It names a gitignored dir minted per run (`target/l4-decision-probe/{arm}-{UTC stamp}`) that the   entry prints as `series out …`. That pins the record to THIS run by construction and changes nothing the probe   grades. - The committed records have no gate as producer: `evidence/shipped-runs.json`, `evidence/nf-runs.json` (the   byte-for-byte copies) and `evidence/series.md` (the reading) are written by Step 5 from those dirs and the two   entries' recorded output. Hygiene then reads them. - Both entries are `leg = 'operator'`. /implement fires each once on the granted slot, and the wrap never re-runs them.   A second run would be a second, unregistered series. - The shipped entry asserts that a verdict line exists, not which verdict. PASS and FAIL both complete the chunk   (P4 ruling). The verdict word is carried into the report's Outcome.

**Absences**, each with its reason: - No `pulse-app/ui/**` path is touched, so there are no webview gates. - No boot-path file is touched, and the probe starts no `pulse-app` and binds no port, so no boot smoke is owed   (test-plan §3 Boot-smoke gate). - There is no harness live leg: the probe spawns its own `llama-cli` children and no externally booted process. So no   liveness probe or `stop` applies. - There is no source delta, so there is no pre-push gate and no operator CI read. The wrap's push runs CI as usual. - No package changes, so `cargo deny` / `cargo audit` are not listed. CI's `supply-chain` job runs them. - No source text changes, so `check:english-sources` is not listed.
